primary.policy: First supported negative prediction in (issue time, sequence) order; then permanently pi_ref

stable.oracle_scope: Evaluation-only best of no intervention and three single-root native suffixes

local_speed_drop.oracle_scope: Evaluation-only best of no intervention and three single-root native suffixes

promotion.decision: Eligible for a separately declared control validation

interpretation.query_metrics: Auxiliary separate single-root evaluations; their sums are not policy costs
interpretation.guard_contribution: stale minus legacy_narrow: identical stale coefficients, broader action support only
interpretation.fresh_contribution: fresh minus stale: identical model and action support, different six-pair supervision
interpretation.line_model_scope: Auxiliary training fit only; no heldout line-model selector evaluation
interpretation.heldout_truth_scope: New native labels only score predictions sealed before branching; no fitting
